dict.string: NeuralCompose connects to your Muse headband over Bluetooth to read EEG locally. EEG data never leaves your machine.

NeuralCompose captures microphone audio (a) while you press and hold the dictation button, and (b) during listening turns of the opt-in Hypnagogic mode while that mode is active. In every case audio is transcribed entirely on-device via Apple's Speech framework and never leaves your machine. Hypnagogic mode is off by default and is shown in the privacy banner while active; only the resulting transcript text — never audio — may be sent to a cloud assistant.

NeuralCompose uses on-device speech recognition to transcribe your speech — while you press and hold the dictation button, and during the opt-in Hypnagogic mode while it is active. Transcription is performed on-device only.

NeuralCompose can receive EEG over your local network from the Mind Monitor app (a Muse headband streaming via OSC), as an alternative to a direct Bluetooth connection. EEG stays on your local network and is never sent to the internet.
